title: How to play
summary: Story stage EX-2 EVENT; challenge mode opens once it is cleared.

sections.title: Rules
items: Score as high as you can (capped at 999,999)
9 holes; tap a Nikke that pops up to hit her with the hammer
750 per hit (the same whether she is popping up, waiting or ducking back down); 1,500 for leaving Mustang alone

sections.title: Difficulty over time
sections.note: A new level every 5 s. Times are read as 1/10,000 s: “Next after” is the pause before another character pops up, “Stays” how long one waits before ducking down.

pages.title: Smash, Soda! - Story Mode
pages.text:
■ In this game, use the hammer and hit the Nikkes that appear to get points.
■ Mustang will occasionally appear. Hitting him will cause your HP to decrease.
■ In the story mode, achieve the target score to clear the stage.

pages.title: Smash, Soda! - Challenge Mode
pages.text:
■ In this game, use the hammer and hit the Nikkes that appear to get points.
■ Mustang will occasionally appear. Hitting him will cause your HP to decrease.
■ In the challenge mode, your goal is to get the highest score possible.
